mapper.select: SELECT id FROM simulations WHERE id = #{simulationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, baseline_simulation_id, baseline_layout_version_id, planner_version, status, baseline_metrics, diagnosis, budget, constraints, requested_by, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message FROM layout_searches WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, baseline_simulation_id, baseline_layout_version_id, planner_version, status, baseline_metrics, diagnosis, budget, constraints, requested_by, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message FROM layout_searches WHERE baseline_simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, baseline_simulation_id, baseline_layout_version_id, planner_version, status, baseline_metrics, diagnosis, budget, constraints, requested_by, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message FROM layout_searches WHERE baseline_simulation_id = #{simulationId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DIAGNOSING', 'GENERATING', 'VERIFYING') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, baseline_simulation_id, baseline_layout_version_id, planner_version, status, baseline_metrics, diagnosis, budget, constraints, requested_by, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message FROM layout_searches WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'DIAGNOSING', 'GENERATING', 'VERIFYING') ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT search.id AS searchId, search.baseline_simulation_id AS baselineSimulationId, COALESCE(NULLIF(simulation.title, ''), layout.title) AS title, search.status FROM layout_searches search JOIN simulations simulation ON simulation.id = search.baseline_simulation_id JOIN layout_versions layout_version ON layout_version.id = simulation.layout_version_id JOIN layouts layout ON layout.id = layout_version.layout_id WHERE search.requested_by = #{requestedBy} ORDER BY search.created_at DESC, search.id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE layout_search_candidates candidate JOIN layout_searches search ON search.id = candidate.study_id SET candidate.status = 'RUNNING' WHERE candidate.id = #{id} AND candidate.status = 'QUEUED' AND search.status IN ('PENDING', 'DIAGNOSING', 'GENERATING', 'VERIFYING')

UPDATE layout_search_trials trial JOIN layout_search_candidates candidate ON candidate.id = trial.candidate_id SET trial.finished_at = #{finishedAt}, trial.failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE candidate.study_id = #{searchId} AND candidate.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND trial.finished_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, study_id, parent_candidate_id, round_index, candidate_order, origin_finding_type, operator_type, status, change_set, rationale, proxy_score, metric_delta, reject_reason, constraints_snapshot, adopted_layout_version_id, prepared_simulation_id, (SELECT status FROM simulations WHERE simulations.id = layout_search_candidates.prepared_simulation_id) AS prepared_simulation_status, adopted_at, created_at FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, study_id, parent_candidate_id, round_index, candidate_order, origin_finding_type, operator_type, status, change_set, rationale, proxy_score, metric_delta, reject_reason, constraints_snapshot, adopted_layout_version_id, prepared_simulation_id, adopted_at, created_at FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, study_id, parent_candidate_id, round_index, candidate_order, origin_finding_type, operator_type, status, change_set, rationale, proxy_score, metric_delta, reject_reason, constraints_snapshot, adopted_layout_version_id, prepared_simulation_id, (SELECT status FROM simulations WHERE simulations.id = layout_search_candidates.prepared_simulation_id) AS prepared_simulation_status, adopted_at, created_at FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE study_id = #{searchId} ORDER BY round_index ASC, candidate_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, study_id, parent_candidate_id, round_index, candidate_order, origin_finding_type, operator_type, status, change_set, rationale, proxy_score, metric_delta, reject_reason, constraints_snapshot, adopted_layout_version_id, prepared_simulation_id, (SELECT status FROM simulations WHERE simulations.id = layout_search_candidates.prepared_simulation_id) AS prepared_simulation_status, adopted_at, created_at FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE study_id = #{studyId} AND round_index = #{roundIndex} ORDER BY candidate_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, study_id, parent_candidate_id, round_index, candidate_order, origin_finding_type, operator_type, status, change_set, rationale, proxy_score, metric_delta, reject_reason, constraints_snapshot, adopted_layout_version_id, prepared_simulation_id, (SELECT status FROM simulations WHERE simulations.id = layout_search_candidates.prepared_simulation_id) AS prepared_simulation_status, adopted_at, created_at FROM layout_search_candidates WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO layout_search_trials (candidate_id, started_at, attempt_count, total_move_distance) VALUES (#{candidateId}, #{startedAt}, 1, #{totalMoveDistance})
mapper.update: UPDATE layout_search_trials SET engine_version = NULL, termination_reason = NULL, metrics = NULL, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = NULL, failure_message = NULL, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND attempt_count < 2
mapper.select: SELECT id, candidate_id, engine_version, termination_reason, metrics, total_move_distance, started_at, finished_at, failure_message, attempt_count FROM layout_search_trials WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId}

SELECT trial.id, trial.candidate_id, trial.engine_version, trial.termination_reason, trial.total_move_distance, trial.metrics, trial.started_at, trial.finished_at, trial.failure_message, trial.attempt_count FROM layout_search_trials trial JOIN layout_search_candidates candidate ON candidate.id = trial.candidate_id WHERE candidate.study_id = #{searchId} ORDER BY trial.started_at ASC, trial.id ASC
SELECT id, candidate_id, engine_version, termination_reason, metrics, total_move_distance, started_at, finished_at, failure_message, attempt_count FROM layout_search_trials WHERE finished_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE layout_search_candidates candidate JOIN layout_search_trials trial ON trial.candidate_id = candidate.id JOIN layout_searches search ON search.id = candidate.study_id SET candidate.status = IF(trial.attempt_count < 2, 'QUEUED', 'FAILED'), candidate.reject_reason = IF(trial.attempt_count < 2, NULL, 'SERVICE_RESTARTED'), trial.finished_at = IF(trial.attempt_count < 2, NULL, #{finishedAt}), trial.failure_message = IF(trial.attempt_count < 2, NULL, #{failureMessage}) WHERE candidate.status = 'RUNNING' AND search.status IN ('PENDING', 'DIAGNOSING', 'GENERATING', 'VERIFYING')
